_comment: Shared by tools/preview.py and pi/vision/leafs.py, so what you frame in the browser is what the scanner analyses.
_sensor_mode_note: 2304x1296 uses the whole sensor. The default 1536x864 mode is a centre crop and looks zoomed in.
_crop_note: Region of interest as [x, y, w, h] in 0..1 fractions. [0, 0, 1, 1] is the whole frame. Cropping here makes the output image genuinely smaller, which is the only size change that saves real work.
_zoom_note: 1.0 is the full frame. 2.0 crops to the middle half and scales back up, so it changes framing but not output size.
_autofocus_note: Continuous autofocus. Without it the lens stays at infinity and a leaf held close is badly blurred. Hunting costs energy, so turn it off once the camera is fixed in place.
